reviewer_identity: The separate Codex worker in the final-review chat, not the implementation agent Codex coordinator; internal AI-assisted review, not human or organizer endorsement.

source.verification: Read both complete languages and the exact local commit/blob. The actual final reproduction checked commit-to-blob binding, blob type, raw SHA-256 and Git SHA-1, exact package source bytes, and current bilingual source modulo CRLF-to-LF only. No remote freshness claim.

statement_alignment.population: Primes p with p % 4 = 1, exactly as named in both source languages; no additional class-number restriction.
statement_alignment.denominator: Cardinality of {p in Finset.range N | p.Prime and p % 4 = 1}; strict p < N, not p <= N, not all primes, and not ambient integers.
statement_alignment.numerator: The same finite eligible population filtered by actual existential integer witnesses to x^2 - p*y^2 = -1.
statement_alignment.conclusion: Under the explicitly disclosed relative-prime-class interpretation, successful and eligible sets agree for every N; the denominator is positive for N >= 6, so the real quotient is eventually 1 and cannot converge to the exact printed product constant in [1/4, 7/16].
statement_alignment.scope: Necessary-density-clause refutation of the printed statement under this disclosed interpretation, not a proof of its wide-class-number preamble or a refutation of a different composite-squarefree-radicand literature conjecture. No claim that this is the only possible density convention.

mathematics.pell: Read the full integer coprime-square split, mod-four parity and minimal-positive-Pell descent. Verified the actual pinned Mathlib fundamental-solution definition and existence theorem have the used hypotheses. No assumed negative-Pell solvability or bounded-search extrapolation.
mathematics.product: Read actual real factor n = 1 - (1/2)^(n+2), summable deviations, multipliability, finite product inequalities and passage to tprod bounds. Indexing starts at k=2; the complementary constant is separated from 1 by exact rational bounds.
mathematics.density: Read actual Finset definitions, equality bridge, prime-5 positive-denominator argument, real ratio, eventual equality, Tendsto and closed limit negation. No hidden density, solution-existence or product-bound premise.
mathematics.python_regressions: Actual exact integer certificates and 80 rational finite-product prefixes passed in reproduction; these diagnostics are not substitutes for the universal Lean proof.

reproduction.clean_scope: Only own lean4/.lake/build was deleted, then Main and its imported mathematical modules were freshly built. All three mathematical sources and Main were actually replayed, followed by actual Check.lean, with warnings as errors.
reproduction.dependency_checks: All nine physical Git dependencies passed exact origin, HEAD, own metadata, tracked raw-byte, index/tree and path checks before and after execution. All authored raw hashes and the coordinator content hash were unchanged.
reproduction.reviewer_harness_note: After the successful command, the reviewer's log extractor initially failed to recognize Windows CRLF. Its diagnostic was retained; only the extractor was corrected, and the same exit-0 log was SHA-256 verified and parsed. The actual reproduction was not rerun, weakened or replaced by prior coordinator/preflight evidence.

lean_bridge.finding: Actual printed types match the advertised mathematical declarations and definition bridges. No sorryAx, custom axiom, hidden conjectural premise, unsafe/native evaluation escape or hard-coded Boolean substitute was found.

tests.boundary: Synthetic focused safety tests; their mocked builds are not used as evidence of actual Lean execution. The separate full actual reproduction above supplies that evidence. All temporary fixtures stayed in the authorized audit directory.

attributes.actual_check: Read rules and ran git check-attr -z text eol diff for mathematical sources, main.tex, source.md and main.pdf. Text files reported text=auto/eol=lf; PDF reported text=unset and diff=unset. PDF bytes were compared raw, never text-normalized.

pdf.visual_method: Independent final pypdf text/page inspection and fresh Poppler pdftoppm -png -r 110 rendering of the byte-identical submitted/rebuilt PDF; each of three page images was individually viewed.
pdf.visual_finding: No clipping, overlap, missing mathematical expression, unreadable source hash or page-boundary defect. Visible and extracted content matches final TeX and the reviewed proof.
pdf.compiler_note: Tectonic printed a nonfatal Fontconfig default-config warning; compilation exited 0 and produced exactly the submitted PDF bytes. No resources were downloaded and the submitted PDF was not overwritten.

evidence.binding: Actual coordinator content_hash function was used before execution, after reproduction/tests/PDF rebuilding, and immediately before signing; the specified frozen hash remained unchanged. Earlier bounded review and research results were not substituted for the final actual checks.

limitations: Installed Lean/compiler and pinned dependency build caches remain trust inputs; only this project's build outputs were cleaned. This is not a clean rebuild of all dependencies or an empty-machine bootstrap.
